description: Codename of the Go port of the TypeScript compiler that became TypeScript 7.
The code was translated with the same structure and logic, so type checking matches TypeScript 6.0.
Control how many type-checking workers and parallel project builds TypeScript 7 uses.
Package exposing the 6.0 JavaScript API and a `tsc6` binary for tools that need the compiler API.
Language Server Protocol, the editor protocol used by TypeScript 7's language server.
Deterministic type ordering, always on in 7.0 and available as a flag in 6.0 to preview differences.
